# netpaytool.com
> Free take-home pay calculator. See your exact net pay after federal, state, and FICA taxes.

## What this tool does
- Calculates net take-home pay after all taxes for any US salary
- Covers all 50 states plus DC
- Applies 2024 IRS federal income tax brackets
- Includes FICA (Social Security 6.2% + Medicare 1.45%)
- Accounts for state income tax rates by state
- Shows effective vs marginal tax rate

## How taxes are calculated
Federal tax uses 2024 IRS brackets (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35%, 37%). State tax uses each state's 2024 effective rate or bracket structure. FICA is applied at the statutory rates. Standard deduction is applied by default.

## Key facts
- On a $75,000 salary in California, take-home pay is approximately $53,000/year
- On a $75,000 salary in Texas (no state income tax), take-home pay is approximately $58,000/year
- FICA taxes alone take ~7.65% of gross income up to the Social Security wage base ($168,600 in 2024)
- The highest combined marginal rate (federal + state + FICA) is roughly 55% in California at top incomes

https://netpaytool.com
